meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求部署网站时,Claude 会用 Vercel 命令进行部署,并在分享网址前先检查构建、部署状态和网页是否正常可用;还能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署/发布/上线网页应用,或管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 请把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会先本地构建,再部署并验证网址。

say.text: 列出我的 Vercel 项目
say.note: Claude 会运行命令显示项目列表。

say.text: 把环境变量 MY_KEY 添加到生产环境
say.note: Claude 会用管道方式添加该变量。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude deploys web apps to Vercel using CLI commands, checks that the build passes, the deployment is ready, and the live URL responds before sharing it. It can also manage projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude builds locally, deploys, then verifies the URL.
Claude runs the command to show projects.

say_en.text: Add environment variable MY_KEY to production.
say_en.note: Claude pipes the value to add the variable.
